readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, Aurèle had each guest bring out a watch for inspection.
When the temple bell struck nine (his watch was two minutes ahead of the bell).
When Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case, after they had played piquet until then.
A moment after Dr Vauthier sat down again in the salon.

durations: Two minutes (his watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell)
A moment (between Dr Vauthier sitting down again and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: Aurèle Monnier gave dinner for the group, including Dr Vauthier, on the last night of the century.
Dr Vauthier and Madame (Odile Monnier) played piquet in the salon after dinner.
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat, which he had forgotten.
Madame began to play the piano while Dr Vauthier was out of the room, and stopped when he came back.
Dr Vauthier came back and sat down again.
